::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 5th 1898  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add MSS 54921: 241
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_942.qmd)
The Clerk of the Peace undertakes to ask the consent of [Mr Portal](people/person_1196.qmd)and the Magistrates at the Quarter Sessions - so there is no doubt that this will be right.[^1]

Could the little wood cut of the Ampfield fountain (in the [book](other_books/otherbook_124.qmd)) be inserted - And one view of the <u>old</u> Hursley  Church would be liked

Otherwise the list is very satisfactory.

That likeness of [Mr Keble](people/person_798.qmd) has never been published, and would be much preferred if we can have it.

Otherwise the one in [Lock’s life](other_books/otherbook_672.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The letter refers to illustrations for *John Keble's Parishes*, which were to include a portrait of Sir William Heathcote hung in the County Hall in Winchester.
